overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Los Angeles Dodgers on winning the 2025 Major League Baseball World Series, beating the Toronto Blue Jays 5 to 4 in extra innings in the seventh game. It notes that this was the franchise's ninth title and its second straight, and highlights players including World Series Most Valuable Player Yoshinobu Yamamoto. It praises the players and staff and directs that copies be sent to the team's owner, president and manager. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on November 20, 2025. It is ceremonial and does not change any law or spending.
for: Supporters say the resolution fittingly honors a historic back-to-back championship that brought pride to Los Angeles and its fans.
against: Critics say the resolution is purely ceremonial and does not change any law or spending.
